name: Vampire
source: Pathfinder Monster Core, Vampire (pg. 334), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=480
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Monster Core is ORC licensed material.
rules: For a living creature of 3rd level or higher. Increase its level by 1; AC, attacks, DCs, saves and skills by 1; Strike damage by 1. Fewer HP, for fast healing and resistance to physical damage (except silver) by its level. Becomes an undead vampire: darkvision, void healing, immunities, coffin restoration, vampire vulnerabilities, a climb Speed equal to its land Speed, claws with Grab and Drink Blood. A true vampire (5th level or higher) also gains Create Servitor, Mist Escape, Change Shape, Children of the Night, Dominate and Turn to Mist.
optional: Damage: only its Strikes deal 1 more; add 1 to its other offensive abilities (2 for limited ones) by hand. It loses abilities that come from being a living creature, and traits of its life other than human, humanoid and the ancestries (removed here): remove those by hand, and adjust abilities that conflict with its theme, such as powers that rely on sunlight or assume vitality. Unholy: vampires usually are; remove it if not. Compulsions: you can give it different ones. A claw Strike it already has doesn't gain Grab here: add it by hand. Change Shape: most vampires become a bat; for a rat, wolf or other creature, use aerial form and animal form as guidelines.

choices.label: True vampire
choices.note: A powerful vampire (5th level or higher) that can create and control vampires: resistance except magical silver; Create Servitor, Mist Escape, Change Shape, Children of the Night, Dominate and Turn to Mist; its Drink Blood drains 2.

choices.label: Write out the abilities' rules text
choices.note: Off: names and numbers only, as Paizo prints vampires (the rules are with the Vampire family in Monster Core). On: Coffin Restoration, the vulnerabilities and each vampire ability with its full text.

abilities.name: Children of the Night
abilities.description: {Name}'s presence brings forth creatures of the night to do the master's bidding. These typically include rat swarms, bat swarms, and wolves but can include other creatures. {Name} can give telepathic orders to these creatures as long as they're within 100 feet, but they can't communicate back.

abilities.name: Coffin Restoration
abilities.description: Unlike other undead, {name} isn't destroyed at 0 HP. Instead, they fall unconscious. If their body rests in their coffin for 1 hour, {name} gains 1 HP, after which their fast healing begins to function normally.

abilities.name: Vampire Vulnerabilities
abilities.description:
All vampires possess the following vulnerabilities.
**Compulsions** {Name} has strange and unknowable compulsions. A typical vampire can't voluntarily cross running water unless they're transported while they hide within their coffin, nor can they enter a private dwelling unless invited in by someone with the authority to do so. The vampire can still be forced to do these things and might be able to overcome their compulsion just as they do their revulsion.
**Revulsion** {Name} can't voluntarily come within 10 feet of brandished garlic or a brandished religious symbol of a deity with a holy sanctification option. To brandish garlic or a religious symbol, a creature must Interact to do so, and it remains brandished for 1 round (similar to Raising a Shield). If {name} involuntarily comes within 10 feet of an object of their revulsion, they gain the fleeing condition, running from the object of their revulsion until they end an action beyond 10 feet. After 1 round of being exposed to the subject of their revulsion, {name} can attempt a DC 25 Will save as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. On a success, they overcome their revulsions for 1d6 rounds (or 1 hour on a critical success).
**Stake** A wooden stake driven through {name}'s heart drops them to 0 HP and prevents them from healing above 0 HP, even in their coffin. Staking a vampire requires 3 actions and works only if the vampire is unconscious. If the stake is removed, the vampire can heal above 0 HP again, and if they're in their coffin, the 1-hour rest period begins once the stake is removed. If the vampire's head is severed and anointed with holy water while the stake is in place, the vampire is destroyed.
**Sunlight** If exposed to direct sunlight, {name} immediately becomes slowed 1. The slowed value increases by 1 each time they end their turn in sunlight, and the condition ends when they're no longer in sunlight. If they lose all their actions in this way, they're destroyed. Due to their supernatural aversion to light, vampires don't cast shadows or show a reflection in mirrors.

abilities.name: Mist Escape
abilities.description: Trigger {Name} is reduced to 0 HP; Effect {Name} uses Turn to Mist. They can take move actions to move toward their coffin even though they're at 0 HP. While at 0 HP in this form, {name} is unaffected by further damage. They automatically return to their corporeal form, unconscious, if they reach their coffin or after 2 hours, whichever comes first.

abilities.name: Change Shape
abilities.description: Giant bat with fangs {strikeattack:best} for {strikedice:claw} piercing.

abilities.name: Change Shape
abilities.description:
{Name} transforms into one of their animal forms or back into their normal form. Most vampires can turn into a bat, but some can turn into a different creature, such as a rat or a wolf. Use the options in the _aerial form_ and _animal form_ spells as guidelines.
**Bat** {Name} changes into a bat swarm or giant bat. They gain echolocation 40 feet, a land Speed of 20 feet and a fly Speed of 30 feet, and a fangs Strike with the same attack bonus as their highest melee attack ({strikeattack:best}). These fangs deal the same amount of damage as their claws ({strikedice:claw}) but deal piercing damage rather than slashing damage.

abilities.name: Create Servitor
abilities.description: If a creature dies after being reduced to 0 HP by Drink Blood, {name} can turn this victim into a vampire servitor by donating some of their own blood to the victim and burying the victim in earth for 3 nights. A vampiric servitor is compelled to obey its creator, but if a vampire controls too many vampiric servitors at once (as determined by the GM), or if the servitor is a higher level than the vampire that created it, strong-willed servitors can free themselves by succeeding at a Will saving throw against {name}'s Will DC.

abilities.name: Dominate
abilities.description: DC {spelldc:high}. {Name} can cast _dominate_ at will as a divine innate spell. Casting it requires staring into the target's eyes, giving the spell the visual trait. A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune to {name}'s Dominate for 24 hours. Fully destroying {name} ends the domination, but merely reducing them to 0 HP is insufficient to break the spell.

abilities.name: Drink Blood
abilities.description:
Requirements A grabbed, paralyzed, restrained, unconscious, or willing creature is within {name}'s reach; Effect {Name} sinks their fangs into that creature to drink their blood. This requires an Athletics check against the victim's Fortitude DC if the victim is grabbed and is automatic for any of the other conditions. The victim is drained 1 and {name} regains HP equal to 10\% of their maximum HP ({=hp / 10} HP), gaining any excess HP as temporary HP. Drinking Blood from a creature that's already drained doesn't restore any HP to {name} but increases the victim's drained value by 1, killing the victim when it reaches drained 5. {Name} can also consume blood that's been emptied into a vessel for sustenance, but they gain no HP from doing so.
A victim's drained condition decreases by 1 per week. A blood transfusion, which requires a DC 20 Medicine check and sufficient blood or a blood donor, reduces the drain by 1 after 10 minutes.

abilities.name: Drink Blood
abilities.description:
Requirements A grabbed, paralyzed, restrained, unconscious, or willing creature is within {name}'s reach; Effect {Name} sinks their fangs into that creature to drink their blood. This requires an Athletics check against the victim's Fortitude DC if the victim is grabbed and is automatic for any of the other conditions. The victim is drained 2 and {name} regains HP equal to 10\% of their maximum HP ({=hp / 10} HP), gaining any excess HP as temporary HP. Drinking Blood from a creature that's already drained doesn't restore any HP to {name} but increases the victim's drained value by 1, killing the victim when it reaches drained 5. {Name} can also consume blood that's been emptied into a vessel for sustenance, but they gain no HP from doing so.
A victim's drained condition decreases by 1 per week. A blood transfusion, which requires a DC 20 Medicine check and sufficient blood or a blood donor, reduces the drain by 1 after 10 minutes.

abilities.name: Turn to Mist
abilities.description: {Name} turns into a cloud of vapor, as the _vapor form_ spell, or back to their normal form. {Name} loses fast healing while turned to mist. They can remain in this form indefinitely.
